calibration.title: Eye Calibration & Privacy
calibration.subtitle: Anatomical Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) calibration over real-time video feed, processed 100% locally.

privacy.title: Privacy Guarantee
privacy.desc: Your video feed never leaves this computer. Frames are analyzed in volatile memory to compute vectors and are instantly overwritten.
privacy.feat1Desc: MediaPipe Face Mesh processes all 468 points locally on your CPU/GPU.
privacy.feat2Desc: No video files or photos are ever saved to disk or uploaded to the cloud.
privacy.feat3Desc: Your profile is stored locally in calibration_config.json.

intercept.title: Active Ocular Break
intercept.desc: Look away from the monitor to relax the ciliary muscle and rehydrate the ocular surface.
intercept.step1Desc: Look through a window or at the farthest object in the room to relax the crystalline lens.
intercept.step2Desc: Blink deeply 5 times in a gentle manner to restore tear film and moisturize the cornea.
intercept.step3Desc: Roll your shoulders smoothly backwards and lower your chin to release neck tension.
intercept.footerNotice: Screen locked to safeguard your ergonomics and visual rest.
intercept.footerAutoUnlock: Will unlock automatically when the countdown ends
